name: submit_intake_draft
description: Update fictional HVAC intake details in browser memory, including corrections. Does not save a request. Report hazardous conditions immediately, even after saving.

email.description: Optional fictional email. Use an empty string to remove it.

phone.description: Fictional U.S. callback number, including country code.

intake_intent.description: Short equipment issue, without diagnosis or repair instructions.

address_line1.description: Complete fictional street address, including unit if applicable.

hazardous_condition.description: True for gas odor, smoke, a carbon monoxide alarm or electrical danger; false only after asking and receiving a negative answer.

name: lookup_approved_faq
description: Look up business-specific facts. Speak only a matched approved_answer; otherwise use fallback_message. Never speak source identifiers.

name: prepare_intake_confirmation
description: Validate the complete current draft without saving. Read returned readback exactly and wait for the customer's answer. Corrections require an updated draft and a new readback.

name: confirm_service_request
description: Save the request and transcript only after the customer says a clear yes following prepare_intake_confirmation's full readback. On a transport error retry this tool; do not create another request.

explicit_confirmation.description: True only after the customer clearly says yes following the complete current readback.

name: check_appointment_availability
description: Check actual internal-calendar slots for the confirmed service ZIP. Offer only returned slots, using their business timezone.

day.description: Exact service date as YYYY-MM-DD. Use returned business_date and timezone to resolve relative dates; if unavailable, ask for an exact date.

name: reserve_appointment
description: Temporarily hold a slot the customer selected from the most recent availability result. Read returned readback exactly. HELD is not booked.

team_key.description: Copy team_key exactly from the selected returned slot.

starts_at.description: Copy starts_at exactly from the selected returned slot, including its timezone offset.

name: confirm_appointment
description: Confirm the current hold only after a clear yes following its full date, time and timezone readback. Say booked only if result has booked=true and appointment.status=CONFIRMED.

explicit_confirmation.description: True only after the customer clearly says yes following the complete current readback.

name: release_appointment_hold
description: Release the current unconfirmed hold when the customer declines it or wants another time. Cannot cancel a confirmed appointment.
